correctness.rationale: Independent exponential first edge-attempt times turn complete coverage into the event of no adjacent failed edges. The two-by-two circular transfer trace has exactly computed eigenvalues. A uniform expansion log(lambda+)=-2u+us+O(u^2), explicit far-left exponential bounds, and dominated convergence in supremum/L1 establish the fractional and near-symmetry limits, optimal Kolmogorov constants, and expectation coefficients. The packaged checker independently passed 77 exact-rational and asymptotic assertions; numerical tests are supporting checks rather than proofs.

originality.rationale: The claim is the asymmetric sharp first Gumbel correction for an alternating-rate edge-cover-time process, its optimal Kolmogorov and mean coefficients, and a moving-rate logarithmic symmetry crossover. Finite exact circular-run distributions and the first-order Poisson/Gumbel phenomenon are expressly excluded from originality. value.rationale: Periodic heterogeneity changes the universal Gumbel convergence rate from square-root order to an arbitrary fractional exponent determined by the weaker rate, and reveals a logarithmic crossover when two rare-run mechanisms compete. Sharp Kolmogorov and expectation coefficients quantify this effect for a natural cyclic coverage/reliability process; these are meaningful distributional quantities not inferred from first-order limits or finite enumeration alone.
